breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification removes the incorrect instruction to treat bending stress as uniform over the section depth. Instead, it instructs to use the 'standard bending stress formula,' which correctly implies a linear stress distribution (σ = My/I) with zero stress at the neutral axis. The erroneous statement about uniform stress and same sign at the neutral axis as at extreme fibers is completely absent from the generated output, matching the ground truth prompt.
